exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.cues: Drive elbows to ribs, hollow core, full hang at bottom.

exercises.name: One-arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.target: 3 x 10 per side, 2s up / 2s down (10 kg)
progressions: Paused DB Row (2s squeeze at top)
exercises.cues: Flat back, pull dumbbell towards hip pocket.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear-Delt Fly
exercises.cues: Hinge at hips, keep slight elbow bend, squeeze rear delts.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.cues: Avoid swinging, curl pelvis upward at the top.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
exercises.cues: Press lower back firmly into floor, tuck chin.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.cues: Elbows pinned to sides, control the descent.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.cues: Body straight as a plank, elbows at 45 degrees.

exercises.name: Pike Push-up
exercises.target: 3 x 6-10 (or DB Overhead Press 10 kg 3 x 10)
exercises.cues: Hips high, head moves forward forming a tripod with hands.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
progressions: Paused DB Floor Press (2s at bottom)
exercises.cues: Upper arms touch floor gently at 45 degrees, drive straight up.

exercises.name: Bench Dips
regressions: Feet bent close to bench dips
exercises.cues: Keep back close to the bench, do not sink into shoulders.

exercises.name: Plank & Side Plank
exercises.cues: Glutes tight, ribs pulled toward hips, breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.cues: Lift chest and thighs off floor, squeeze glutes and upper back.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.cues: Back foot on chair, slow 3s eccentric, drive through front heel.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.target: 3 x 8 per leg (DB in opposite hand, 3s lowering)
exercises.cues: Hinge at hips, keep back straight, slight bend in standing knee.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.target: Straight knee 3 x 12, Bent knee 2 x 12 per leg
progressions: Weighted Single-Leg Calf Raise (10 kg DB)
exercises.cues: Full stretch at bottom, rise onto big toe, 2s hold at top.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.cues: Drive through heel, do not hyperextend lower back.

exercises.name: Pogo Hops & Skipping
exercises.target: Pogo hops 2-3 x 15-20, skipping 3 x 20m, side-step lunges 2 x 8/side
exercises.cues: Stiff ankles, quick bounce off ground, quiet landings. Skip if sore.

UA.title: Upper A: Pull + Core
UA.warmup: Arm circles, scapular pull-ups, cat-cow, towel shoulder dislocates (5 min)

UB.title: Upper B: Push + Core
UB.warmup: Arm circles, wrist rolls, incline push-ups x 10 (5 min)

UC.title: Upper C: Skills & Light
UC.warmup: Light arm circles and wrist mobility (3 min)
UC.instructions: Dead hang 3 x 20s, scapular pull-ups 3 x 8, easy push-up ladder, L-sit practice, 5' mobility.

LEG_A.title: Leg A: Strength
LEG_A.warmup: Bodyweight squats and hip circles (3 min)
LEG_A.instructions: Slow 3s lowering on every rep. Bodyweight in weeks 1-2, then add 10 kg dumbbells.

LEG_B.title: Leg B: Plyometric & Stability
LEG_B.warmup: Ankle circles and high knees (3 min)
LEG_B.instructions: Weeks 1-2: glute bridges + calf raises. Week 3+: add pogo hops and skipping. Skip jumps if sore.

FINALS_MINI.title: Finals Mini
FINALS_MINI.instructions: 3 rounds, no failure: pull-ups (comfortable reps), push-ups (comfortable reps), hollow hold 20s. Rest 60s between rounds.

MOBILITY.title: Mobility Routine
MOBILITY.instructions: Hip flexor stretch, hamstring stretch, calf stretch, pigeon pose, thoracic rotation, shoulder opener (10-15 min).

steps.name: Chin tucks
steps.detail: 2 x 10, 3s hold (lying down or against wall)

steps.name: Thoracic extension
steps.detail: 2 x 8 slow reps over rolled towel / chair back
